notes: User is managing sleep quality, anxiety, self-care, and healthy boundaries, while sometimes struggling to fall asleep despite journaling and a consistent schedule. Yoga and meditation help anxiety and may support sleep. They work 9–5 Monday–Friday, attend weekly yoga, and have biweekly dinners with friends, but feel overwhelmed by work/social commitments and struggle to say no to colleagues and friends. They prefer a flexible planning approach rather than a strict schedule and want help prioritizing tasks without burning out. A suitable checklist includes: identify 3–5 daily must-dos; protect self-care such as meditation and journaling; decline nonessential commitments; communicate priorities and boundaries; leave buffer time; and review priorities/commitments weekly. They recently found a session with Dr. Smith helpful and feel more confident setting boundaries; current notes should reflect that Dr. Smith is now seen weekly. They are ending the conversation to meditate and journal. Continue encouraging flexibility, self-compassion, and follow-up with Dr. Smith as appropriate.
